passages.english: The mystery of this ark is expounded by Cyprian, the most blessed martyr, writing in the book On the Simplicity of Prelates, or rather, according to the old copies, On the Unity of the Catholic Church: "The bride of Christ cannot be made an adulteress: she is uncorrupted and chaste; she knows one home, and guards with chaste modesty the sanctity of one bedchamber. She keeps us for God; she assigns to the kingdom the sons whom she has borne.
